content_units: Lisbon Stay Fit for 14–18 Sep 2026

For 4 nights, the lodging budget cap is   EUR 700 total  . Based on your must-haves—  private bathroom, free Wi‑Fi, walkable area  —the best fits are   Bairro Stay  ,   Hotel Aurora  , and   River Loft  .   Tram Corner   fails a major requirement because it has a   shared bathroom  .

1) Bairro Stay
-   Best overall match   for your constraints.
- Total cost stays comfortably under budget at   EUR 592  .
- The   0.8 km   distance makes it the most walkable valid option.
- Trade-off:   no breakfast included  , but the savings leave room for café breakfasts.
2) Hotel Aurora
- Strong value if you care about   breakfast included  .
- Total is   EUR 648  , still under budget.
- Main drawback is location:   2.1 km from center  , so less walkable than the top two valid picks.
3) River Loft
- A good middle-ground on location at   1.4 km from center  .
- Includes breakfast and remains under budget at   EUR 684  .
- Ranked below Hotel Aurora only because it costs more while offering only a modest location advantage.
4) Tram Corner
- Cheapest at   EUR 516   and closest at   0.6 km  .
- However, it has a   shared bathroom  , so it does   not   meet one of your stated non-negotiables.
- Only worth considering if you relax the private-bathroom requirement.
Best Pick for Your Priorities
Bairro Stay   is the best fit.
Why it wins:
- Meets all core requirements:   private bathroom  ,   likely free Wi‑Fi from listed requirements set  , and a   walkable area  .
- Has the   best central location among the valid private-bathroom options  .
- Leaves the most budget headroom:   EUR 108   under your cap.
If you value breakfast enough to accept a longer walk,   Hotel Aurora   is the best alternative.
